race.description: Carpet One Dubbo Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: KNIGHTS TEMPLAR (2) finally got into the placings at Narromine and while some way back, showed a likely benefit of a wet track. May need that again but has made some improvement. HANGONASEQ (11) could be a bit the same however he was a pretty good effort on his debut. He sat back in the field and made good late ground. Every chance he can build on that and now has the blinkers on. RECOGNITION (5) has been around the mark in many of his starts without getting that win. Has run in some decent form maidens too. CASTRO (1) has been looking for this trip. He has run most of his best races here.
